content: AWS SAM official docs: esbuild bundling via Metadata BuildMethod: esbuild with BuildProperties (EntryPoints, Format esm, Minify, Target, OutExtension, Sourcemap, External, MainFields). sam build --build-in-source supports Node runtimes + esbuild build method and builds directly in the source tree (needed so pnpm workspace symlinks in node_modules stay resolvable); --mount-symlinks mounts top-level symlinks (by default symlinks are NOT mounted except those needed by build-in-source for node_modules). Corroborates project research: with pnpm workspaces, sam build needs --build-in-source (or --mount-symlinks) or esbuild cannot resolve workspace-linked @breeze/core.
